cause: Two long canvas exports were interrupted with exit 137 after large native-buffer accumulation. Short encoded diagnostics had not exposed this sustained-memory condition.
resolution: Periodic collection of unreachable native allocations, one full-resolution worker at a time, and checksum-verified segment resume. Pixel generation, encoder settings, source timing and approved input identities are unchanged.
scope: Early sustained-run samples; final delivery checks determine whether the resumed files are valid. No acoustic accuracy claim.
